title: A Beautiful Bargain
shortLine: Youth has a price. Every six months, someone else must pay it.
synopsis: Jennifer, a wealthy Parisian beauty-parlour owner, cannot bear the prospect of growing old. A mysterious bargain restores her youth in exchange for a young woman every six months. As the price of beauty draws closer to home, she must face what she is willing to sacrifice—and what she cannot bring herself to surrender.
imageAlt: An elegant fashion portrait in a muted, moody setting
detailLine: Beauty can become a debt that never stops collecting.
underneath: The bargain turns a culture’s worship of youth into a literal economy of stolen lives. Jennifer’s final refusal does not erase the people she has already treated as currency.
visualMotifs: A mirror clouded at the edges
A rose browning from the centre
A beautiful face split by shadow
coreQuestion: If you have survived by treating other people as the price of your happiness, can one act of love redeem the bargain?
